dialogues.speaker: Varesa
dialogues.text: This photo is amazing. Should we take a few more?

dialogues.speaker: Alrani
dialogues.text: Let's do it. We can try some other poses.

dialogues.speaker: Varesa
dialogues.text: Alright, in that case, I'd better go grab some comics. We can look through them for reference.

dialogues.speaker: Alrani
dialogues.text: Hmm, but there's too many good ones to choose from... We'll probably get so caught up in reading comics that we forget to take the photos...
